# Haiagaru 1.7.5 プレリリース

1.7.2をベースにした修正版です。取り下げた1.7.3／1.7.4の実装を一括で戻すものではありません。公式安定版は引き続き1.7.1です。

## 今回の修正

- ホーム／履歴の複数選択で、タップした見出しの直後から次の見出しまでを選択します。未選択のスレがあれば追加し、範囲内がすべて選択済みなら解除します。範囲外の選択は維持します。
- 上記の処理を226 dev／241／242 devで修正しました。191 devの既存の範囲選択は維持しています。
- 191 dev／226 devで、BEアイコン補正後のリンク下線・リンク先が前の行の「391(c)2ch.net」へずれる問題を修正しました。
- 最終表示テキスト全体からリンクに対応する文字列を探し、元の位置に最も近い一致箇所へ下線を合わせます。旧形式の文章末尾ホストと次行のURLの組み合わせは、条件を限定してリンク先も補正します。

## 対応・検証

- 主な対象：ChMate 0.8.10.191 dev／0.8.10.226 dev／0.8.10.241／0.8.10.242 dev。243 devは一部未実装のため非推奨です。
- BEリンク補正の回帰テスト、226／241／242の範囲選択テスト、Android MPPビルドを確認しています。
- 今回の修正の実機操作確認は未実施です。利用前にバックアップをお願いします。
- 1.7.2までの追加機能は[1.7.2の更新内容](https://github.com/areteruhiro/Haiagaru-Morphe/releases/tag/1.7.2)をご覧ください。

## 配布物

- `haiagaru_patches-1.7.5.mpp` と `patches-1.7.5.mpp` は同一のAndroid版Morphe用パッチバンドルです。
- プレ版のバンドルを1.7.5へ更新します。通常版は1.7.1のままです。

## What changed

Two fixes for TikTok 46.9.3, one of them a crash (#12).

**Feed filter crashed TikTok on 46.9.3.** That build moved the Following feed's data class to Kotlin and renamed the field that holds its videos. Feed filter still asked for the old name, which on 46.9.3 is not a normal error but one that ends the app, so TikTok closed as soon as the Following feed loaded. The filter now finds the list under either name, and its Following hooks can no longer take the app down if a later build moves things again.

**A download fallback never ran on 46.9.3.** The same build renamed a video's two playback addresses. Downloads caught that one, so nothing crashed, but a video with no clean download address no longer fell back to its playback address. It does again.

**A new check so this doesn't recur.** Hushfeed's code is compiled against stand-ins for TikTok's classes, so a renamed field still builds and still patches, and only fails on a phone. A new test reads the built code and looks up every TikTok field and method it uses in each retained TikTok build. On the previous release it names exactly these three renames.

**Validation.** 1430 runtime tests and 241 patch tests passed locally. The receipt attached below records all 91 patches applying to the 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures with the real desktop CLI. On a Galaxy S22, 46.9.3 patched with Feed filter crashed at launch before the fix and opens the Following feed after it. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

Everything in this release is listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/hushfeed/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md). The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.

# Haiagaru 1.7.0

Haiagaru 1.5.2からの変更点をまとめた正式リリースです。
1.5.3～1.6.11の先行版での改善と、今回のワッチョイ検索・文字列置換・リンク表示の修正を含みます。
配布するMPPはAndroid版Morphe向けです。

## 対応するChMate

- 0.8.10.191 dev
- 0.8.10.226 dev　＊226は書き込み自体の長押しで"ワッチョイで検索"が可能です。
- 0.8.10.241
- 0.8.10.242 dev（1.5.2から追加）
- 0.8.10.243 dev：一部機能未実装のため非推奨。今回追加の外部TXTによる本文置換は対象外です。

## 1.5.2からの主な変更

### 必死チェッカー・KyodemoをChMate内で使いやすく

- hissi.org／KyodemoをChMate内の専用ビュワーで表示。対応する外部板でもID検索メニューを利用できます。
- 検索先を自動／hissi.org／Kyodemo／両方から選択でき、前回の選択も記憶します。自動選択ではBBSPINKもhissi.orgを使います。
- 検索結果内の書き込みURLから、元の掲示板のスレをChMateで開けるようにしました。
- 端末設定／ライト／ダーク／AMOLEDブラックの配色、縦持ちでの本文折り返し、上部の表示領域を改善しました。
- レスを長押しして、レス番号・名前・ID・本文・レスのURL・ヘッダー＋本文のコピーや文字選択ができます。「全レス」と「本文」のコピー内容も区別しました。
- 更新ボタン、左右スワイプの戻る／進む、方向の設定、戻る履歴がない場合の終了に対応。ツールボタンの表示も選べます。
- 専用ビュワーを使わない設定・パッチ適用時オプションを追加しました。
- ワッチョイ長押しの検索メニューと、選択したレスからのID／ワッチョイ引き継ぎを改善しました。
- ワッチョイはラベル・全文・大小文字・記号を保持して渡します。固定桁数・英数字制限を緩和し、`+`／`/`が欠落する問題も修正しました。
- ワッチョイ長押しからの検索は、毎回の入力確認を省いて直接開きます。手動の「ID/ﾜｯﾁｮｲ」入力は引き続き利用できます。

- Kyodemoの傾向表示と、利用可能な分析リクエストへの導線を改善。分析後に自動リクエストを繰り返すループを抑止しました。通信失敗時は「しばらくしてもう一度お試しください」と表示します。

### バックアップ・復元・起動時同期

- MEGAへのバックアップ／復元と、同期元→同期先・双方向の不足分補完を追加しました。
- お気に入り、NG設定、表示履歴、設定、書き込み履歴（postDataList.json／kakikomi.txt）、Cookieなどから対象項目を選べます。
- 分／時間／日単位の間隔設定、起動時のバックアップと最新バックアップの確認に対応しました。アプリを閉じている間のバックグラウンド同期は行いません。
- 復元前に変更箇所を確認するダイアログを追加。確認表示は設定で切り替えられます。
- Androidのファイル選択画面を使ったローカルバックアップ／復元も追加しました。

### エッヂ過去ログ・記者ID

- エッヂ過去ログサイトを利用したアプリ内検索・結果一覧を追加しました。
- タイトルのAND／OR、除外語、半角全角の曖昧検索、レス数、並べ替え、開始日・終了日の詳細条件を利用できます。
- ホーム、板カテゴリ一覧、板のスレ一覧のツールバーに「エッジ過去ログ」を追加しました。
- 元サイト表示のダークモードと、ステータスバーに重なる表示を改善しました。
- 記者IDの編集・NG登録の互換処理を改善。スレタイをコピーする際は表示用の記者IDを除外します。
- 過去ログ画面を開けない場合のエラーコードと診断ログを追加しました。

### スレ表示・フィルター・絵文字

- フィルターをツールバーから開けるようにし、上部の元のフィルター行を隠す設定を追加しました。
- スレの先頭を一度も表示していない場合にフィルターが開けない問題や、旧行を隠した際の余白を改善しました。
- チェックボックス形式でフィルターを切り替え、画像項目の長押しから画像一覧を開けます。
- 「未読数を0にする」でスレ一覧が空になる問題と、新着バッジが残る問題を修正しました。
- レスが少ないスレを上詰めにする設定、既読スレを優先する並べ替えを追加しました。
- 絵文字の表示補正とフォント設定を改善しました。
- 191／226で古いBEアイコンの重複と、URL・`ttp://`形式のリンク下線がずれる問題を修正しました。
- 191／226／241／242に、外部TXTによる本文の文字列置換を追加しました。Haiagaru設定からON/OFFでき、初期状態はOFFです。
- `Download/Haiagaru/ReplaceStr.txt`のサンプル作成、TXT選択、再読み込みに対応。通常置換をリンク認識前に適用し、保存DAT・投稿本文・元のNG判定は変更しません。正規表現・名前やタイトルの置換は未対応です。

### 安定性・パッチ適用

- Talk投稿、UPLIFT利用時、パッケージ名・再署名に関係する0除算／不正な添字／null参照などの互換処理を改善しました。
- パッケージ名やアプリ名を変更した際の起動時クラス名復号、同期設定などでのクラッシュを改善しました。
- 191の自動NG画像判定でTFLite実行に関連するクラッシュ対策を追加。適用はオプションで切り替えられます。
- 191以外でパッチ適用が重くなる処理を絞り込み、負荷を低減しました。
- クラッシュログ保存は初期状態ON。Android向けMPPとバンドルメタデータの配布を更新しました。

## 更新時の注意・確認範囲

- 既存データをバックアップし、**元のChMate APK**に1.7.0のパッチを適用してください。パッチ済みAPKへの重ね掛けは推奨しません。

HushGram v0.0.5 has 48 patches for Instagram 449.0.0.52.84 (arm64-v8a, version code 385511871), two more than v0.0.4. The new ones are Hide the notes row and View DM photos and videos anonymously, and both start off until you turn them on. This release needs Morphe Manager 1.33.0 or newer. It still runs on Android 9 and newer. Here's everything that changed.

## Instagram

* HushGram 0.0.5 adds two patches, for 48 in all, and still targets Instagram 449.0.0.52.84 (build 385511871, arm64-v8a) on Android 9 and newer.
* HushGram now builds on Morphe patcher 1.15.0, so it needs Morphe Manager 1.33.0 or newer. Manager 1.32.0 asks for an update before it loads the bundle.
* New patch, `Hide the notes row`, in Manager's simple mode with its switch off. Turn it on under Messages in HushGram settings and the row of notes at the top of your messages goes, along with the Map bubble that sits in it. Your chats, search and message requests stay where they are. Asked for in #17.
* HushGram's settings come in Korean now, translated by @BlackGold8282 in #36.
* Following-list labels now wait for Instagram's row friendship status instead of trusting a stale profile fallback, so accounts won't show "Doesn't follow you" until their profile refreshes.
* Pure black dark mode now leaves bottom navigation icon colors alone when they share Instagram's dark Prism value, so the buttons stay visible on black backgrounds.
* The source catalog makes six initially neutral controls available in Manager's simple mode. Copy comment, Save comment photo, Hide highlights, Stop swipe to create and Stop Reels scrolling still start off. Story ring size starts at Instagram's own size. Saved choices stay intact. Stop swipe to create checks its switch before making added native reads, so off, Pause and startup before settings are ready retain the original path.
* Keep Reels auto scroll on remembers a completed future timer immediately, so it stays on even if the timer expires before another reel checks it. Cancelled choices, expired timestamps and paused runs keep their usual behavior. Its startup summary appears once at each readiness state, including when checks run together.
* Stop Story auto-advance checks the actual story loop flag before adding its guard. Hide highlights refuses branches into the row's type read or add. Native bundle checks pin the story guard's exact loop call and preserve the original handler's call.
* Story retry patching checks that the native queue count and account reads leave pending batches alone. It refuses subclasses of the final story store, including inherited builder references hidden in encoded handles. A retry bridge with no executable DEX body also stops patching.
* About and local diagnostic reports show the production build identity, so different source builds of the same version can be identified.
* Turning all three suggestion switches under Feed off restores Instagram's own empty feed behavior in the same run. Removing a suggestion earlier no longer keeps the filtered feed's end state active.
* Settings ignore stale accessibility clicks after a containing section is removed or the page closes. Disabling a container disables its controls' accessibility actions. Search refuses edits and Clear after its page closes. A focus-clear action releases the search view hold even when accessibility is off. Android 9 and 17 regressions cover current screen changes and disabled ancestors.
* Override recovery keeps the selected saved copy through interrupted saves and moves. Cleanup failures stay visible even when changes have already applied. Restore removes temporary replacement copies after recovery finishes, and Discard can remove a damaged backup or recovery record. It also recovers when a lone completion record can't be read. The terminal recovery journal is moved to a completion record, keeping imports blocked while its final storage flush fails even if no replacement file can be written.
* View stories anonymously keeps saved batches held if reading the switch, choosing marked stories or creating their batch fails, including an allocation failure. Every retry checks the batch again before Instagram takes ownership or creates a request. It no longer removes a held batch or falls back to sending its original contents. Turning the switch off or pausing keeps Instagram's usual behavior.
* Import, Restore and Discard recheck their permission after reading native state. Turning Allow importing overrides off or pausing while an import waits now stops it before any typed write or recovery-file change. Permission is checked again after file staging and before the first native change, preserving the earlier saved copy if permission changed.
* Added the opt-in patch `View DM photos and videos anonymously`, with a separate switch that starts off. It holds back the visual photo/video opened receipt and completes Instagram's queued visual task locally. Ordinary message and voice receipts keep their existing path.
* `Hide Meta AI` now covers its optional message composer buttons through Instagram's existing visibility and layout path, and omits the optional inbox row through its native empty-row branch. Native fixture tests preserve ordinary controls and thread lists.
* Same-key provider trust now checks the caller's actual current signing key after Instagram's native decision. Only named family apps in the same Android user can qualify. Other provider policies and the original deep-link certificate answers stay intact.
* Disable analytics also skips contacts and location setup delivered through the direct screen presenter. It checks the same two setup screen identifiers and keeps the native path for ordinary screens and absent screen data.
* Open MetaConfig overrides passed the signed-out Samsung check. Its row kept the complete unavailable reason and settings stayed open.
* The reporter confirmed that Clean up Reels now hides the friends' activity and closed #7.
* The reporter confirmed Discover people and suggested users in Reels in #15.

## Tooling

* smali now matches the commit patcher 1.15.0 asks for. The old pin was one commit behind it but sorted higher, so Gradle had been compiling and testing against the older dexlib2. The fixture gates move to desktop CLI 1.18.0.
* Wrapper checks find Git Bash when Git hooks resolve an internal Git executable. The authentic Windows and POSIX launchers and every refusal-before-execution check remain required.
* Local builds default to two workers at low priority, with parallel project builds off. Patch tests use a 4 GB heap instead of 8 GB, and test JVMs limit their internal processor count to two. Build caching stays on.
* Bug reports offer direct messages, profiles and Explore, with a link to local diagnostics and build details. The settings guide separates confirmed suggestion controls from optional profile rows, and the source guide matches the latest recorded census. Manager's story patch description matches the guide.
* Refuse ignored compiler and packaging inputs in production source sets before building or certifying a current dependency audit. Git ignore rules can no longer hide shipped code from its build identity. Staged development inputs still use their current working bytes, and release receipts still require clean sources. Debug, test and generated files remain excluded.
* Local patching checks each selected bundle's exact targets and dependencies before merging or changing an APK. Reports identify the bundle by its hash and attribute initializer failures to their dependency owner. Conflicting selected extension definitions are refused, while compatible addons keep their native initialization. Bug reports now ask which sources and bundle versions were selected.
* New release receipts map the canonical source, catalog and toolchain identity to final bundle and extension hashes. The identity includes Android release source sets, so a change there produces a different identity even when the version stays the same. Debug and test inputs stay excluded. Historical receipts keep their original reading rules.
* Every required Android boundary result now names its actual Android SDK, including the highest SDK in a test class. The gate refuses Android 16 results substituted for Android 17 and results with their platform label removed. All provider caller cases remain required. Self-tests also check missing, filtered, skipped, failed and duplicate results through the real Gradle task, then restore the original report.
* Both Gradle launchers verify the reviewed wrapper JAR and distribution checksum before wrapper code runs. Altered, missing or unreviewed wrappers stop direct builds and scripted builds with a useful error. The push gate exercises both launchers with a runnable replacement JAR.
* Bind current dependency audits to source, catalog, toolchain, SBOM and bundle bytes, preserve resolved dependency edges, and update affected settings and UTP tools to compatible Commons Lang and HttpClient fixes.
* The shipped SBOM now records reviewed Apache 2.0 licenses for its exact Gson, Kotlin stdlib and JetBrains annotations artifacts. Publisher POM and binary hashes bind each record. NOTICE names the carried libraries. Current dependency audits and new release receipts refuse omitted libraries, missing evidence or substituted hashes while historical receipts stay readable.
* Added local Crowdin setup with resumable draft imports and a review package for German, Spanish, Indonesian, Brazilian Portuguese, Turkish and Korean. Setup requires the owner's token, preserves existing reviewer work and never approves translations. Translation tests now run before a related push.
* Gave the native patch test suite enough heap for the expanded fixture proofs. The default test-worker heap ran out while reading whole APK methods.
* Story retry proofs now reject callers that bypass the protected queue, including additional interfaces and stored method handles. They also reject changed ownership predicates and mismatched disk cleanup arguments. Native helper bodies identify the saved key and cleanup operation. The DEX contract checks the story store guard and the null branch before ownership changes.

## Install or update

* Update Morphe Manager to 1.33.0 or newer first. Older versions ask for an update before they load this bundle.
* Add the source with the link in the README, or update it if you already have it.
* Patch the arm64-v8a build of Instagram 449.0.0.52.84, version code 385511871. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK.
* Keep the manager's signing key for updates, so a new build installs over the old one and you stay signed in.
* Read Before you sign in in the README first. A spare account keeps your main one out of it.

## Validation

1491 runtime tests and all 686 patch tests passed locally. All 48 patches applied to Instagram 449.0.0.52.84 without forcing, and the resource and injected-code checks passed. The receipt and SHA256SUMS.txt beside the bundle list every file's hash.

7e4f19d0fead60e17ddf74d2:
## What changed

**Separate share lists for profiles and LIVEs.** Until now one list decided what the share sheet hid everywhere, so hiding Report on a profile hid it on videos too. A LIVE's actions also have their own names, which the old list never reached. The Share sheet page now has three checklists: the original one for videos, plus Profile share actions and LIVE share actions. Each offers only the actions that sheet has shown you. Until you save a choice in the new ones, they hide whatever your video list hides, so nothing you set up before changes.

**Downloads on larger builds.** The Downloads patch refused TikTok builds where the step that names a finished download has more working space than usual, and failed to patch. A reporter's 46.8.3 hit this (#9). It now works whatever the size.

**Clearer errors from the cleanup patches.** The four optional cleanup patches only empty files they've checked byte for byte against a known TikTok APK, and refuse anything else. That refusal used to read like a fault. It now says nothing was removed and what to do: untick the patch, or patch the full APK from APKMirror. A split bundle (an .apkm file) can cause it.

**Validation.** 1427 runtime tests and 236 patch tests passed locally. The receipt attached below records all 91 patches applying to the 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures with the real desktop CLI. On a Galaxy S22 running 46.2.3, Report ticked in the profile list alone disappeared from a profile's share sheet and stayed on a video's, across a restart, and a LIVE's share sheet filled the LIVE list with its own actions. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

Everything in this release is listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/hushfeed/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md). The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.

HushGram's first release: 21 patches for Instagram 449.0.0.52.84 (arm64-v8a, version code 385511871), on Android 9 and newer.

**Install.** You need Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. Add HushGram as a patch source with this link: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushGram. Then patch the arm64-v8a build of Instagram 449.0.0.52.84. The `.mpp` here is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK. Uninstall the Play Store Instagram first, and keep Manager's signing key for updates.

**Before you sign in,** read the section of that name in the README. Instagram checks the app when you sign in, and a re-signed build can't pass those checks, so use an account you've had a while and don't clear the app's data afterward.

## What's in it

* New patch, `Hide ads`. Sponsored posts, reels and stories don't go in, and Instagram is told the ad didn't go in, so it doesn't leave a gap.
* New patch, `Sanitize sharing links`. Copy link, the Android share sheet and the app buttons in Instagram's own share sheet (WhatsApp, SMS and the rest, which skip Android's) lose `stkn` (the per-share id Instagram 449 adds to every shared link), `igsh`, `igshid`, `utm_source` and Instagram's other tracking keys, and so do the post and story links Instagram's server hands out for sharing. Keys come off Instagram's own links only. A link in someone's bio opens its page directly instead of going through `l.instagram.com`, Instagram's click tracker.
* New patch, `Disable analytics`. Instagram's usage events go to your phone's loopback address, which refuses them, instead of to Instagram's and Facebook's logging servers.
* New patch, `Remove build expired popup`. A patched Instagram doesn't update itself, and without this Instagram locks it out after a few weeks with a screen that says the version is too old.
* `Restore trust on re-signed builds`, from Hushfacebook. Instagram's own signature checks see Instagram's two original certificates on a build you signed yourself.
* `HushGram settings`, from Hushfacebook: a switch for each feature, Pause, automatic safe mode after three quick crashes in a row, Debug logging and a diagnostic report that leaves out links, IDs, cookies and sign-in tokens. It opens from a shortcut on Instagram's launcher icon or from a row at the top of Instagram's own Settings and activity screen, and the shortcut works before you sign in too: when Instagram's sign-in screen comes up over it, the settings move in front.
* Runs on Android 9 and newer, which is Instagram 449's own floor. The settings screen, the launcher shortcut, safe mode and the report export all have Android 9 and 10 paths, since Hushfacebook's code expected Android 11.
* German, Spanish, Indonesian, Brazilian Portuguese and Turkish translations for everything HushGram shows.
* Checked beside a patched Threads signed with the same key: neither declares anything the other does, and both open and run side by side.
* New patch, `Clean up Reels`. The Follow button beside a reel's author goes, and so do the pills that push Edits, templates, Meta AI and Ray-Ban Meta glasses, and friends' activity with the comment preview. Each of the three has its own switch under Reels, and they're all on once the patch is in.
* New patch, `Don't send reel watch history`. Instagram isn't told which reels you watched or how far into them you got. It only uses that to rank your Reels, so reels you've already seen may come back.
* New patch, `Hide Reels in the feed`. The rows of suggested reels between posts in your home feed are gone, along with the other units that open the Reels viewer from there. A reel from someone you follow still shows as a post.
* New patch, `Download any reel`. Every reel's more menu has Download, including the shorter menu some accounts get, and a tap saves the reel at your download quality (the best there is by default) without Instagram's watermark. Its switch is under Reels.
* New patch, `Download any story`. The menu on anyone's story has Download. A video story saves at your download quality and a photo story at its largest size, into the same folders as reels. Its switch is under Stories.
* New patch, `Download any video`, off until you pick it. Someone else's post in your feed that is a video gets Download in its menu, first in the short menu most posts open now, including the one under an "About this reel" summary. A tap saves it at your download quality without Instagram's watermark. On your own video, Instagram's own Download row, where it shows one, saves the same way. Its switch is under Downloads.
* New patch, `Tap to play`, off until you pick it. Videos, reels and stories wait for your tap instead of starting on their own, and feed videos show a play button that goes away once your tap starts the video and comes back when it stops. A story or video that takes a few seconds to load after your tap still starts. In Reels, a tap on a reel that's waiting starts it and a tap on a playing one pauses it. A story that's waiting starts when you press, hold and let go, the way a paused one does. A video you started keeps playing when you drag its scrubber. Its switch is in a new Playback section.
* New patch, `Resume long videos`. A video or reel over two minutes that you left partway picks up there the next time it plays, once. Drag the scrubber to start somewhere else. Live videos, ads and anything you watched to the end start as usual. Its switch under Playback starts off, and the spots it keeps are dropped after 30 days.
* New patch, `Default playback quality`, off until you pick it, for anyone who wants to save data or always get the sharpest picture. Pick Data saver, Up to 480p, Up to 720p or Highest under Playback in HushGram's settings, and videos, reels and video stories start at that quality where Instagram offers it. A video with nothing at or under your pick plays the closest quality above. Instagram has no quality menu of its own, so this is the only way to choose one. Once it's in, the list starts at Auto, Instagram's own choice, so nothing changes until you pick a quality. Checked on a phone: a reel started at 240p with Data saver and at 1080p with Highest, and a video story took the pick too.
* New patch, `View stories anonymously`, off until you pick it. Instagram isn't told which stories you watch, so you stay off their viewer lists. Replying or reacting still shows you, and a story you've watched can show as new again. Its switch is in the Stories section.
* New patch, `Remove the advertising ID`. Instagram can't read your phone's advertising ID or tell Android's ad services which ads you saw or tapped, because the permissions for them are taken out of the build. It shows under Set when you patched.
* New patch, `Turn off double tap to like`, off until you pick it. A double tap on a reel or on any post in the feed, whether it's a photo, a carousel or a video, doesn't like it, and the heart doesn't show. A single tap, double tap to skip and the Like button work as before. Its switch is under Reels.
* New patch, `Open links in external browser`, on by default. A web link you tap opens in your default browser instead of Instagram's in-app browser, and a bio or caption link skips Instagram's click tracker on the way. Pages on Instagram, Facebook, Messenger, Threads and Meta stay in the app, and so do ads. Its switch is under Ads and privacy.
* New patch, `Hide the Reels tab`, off until you pick it. Reels leaves the tab bar, and a start or a notification meant for it opens Home, including on accounts Instagram opens on Reels. Reels in your feed and shared reels still play. Its switch is under Reels and takes effect after Instagram restarts.
* New Downloads section in HushGram's settings. It lists the saves that are running, each with a Cancel button, and holds the download quality, the save folder, the video file name and a switch that saves videos other apps can open.
* New patch, `Stop Story auto-advance`. A story stays on screen until you tap or swipe, however long it runs. Turn its switch off for Instagram's timing.
* `Disable analytics` also covers the analytics address Instagram's server can hand its push connection. Before, only the address built into the app went to the loopback address, and a different one from the server went through as is.
* With Debug logging on, the diagnostic report says what `Disable analytics` did with each analytics address Instagram used, and which of Instagram's processes asked for it. Checked on a phone: with the switch on, nothing reached Instagram's logging server at all.
* HushGram's settings screen opens with a Before you sign in note under the status line: how to sign in with the least risk to your account. The settings open before you sign in too, so it's there when it matters. A tap hides it for good, and pausing HushGram doesn't bring it back. Checked on a phone in English and German.
* Morphe Manager and bundle sites like morphe-patches.software show HushGram's own icon next to the source instead of the owner's GitHub picture. The icon is `patches-bundle.png` in the repository's root.
* README now leads with a Before you sign in section that spells out how to keep your account: the sign-in is the moment Instagram checks the app with Play Integrity and your phone's hardware, so use a seasoned account, prefer a Root Mount install if you're rooted, and don't clear the app's data afterward. The account section says plainly that a re-signed build can't pass those checks.

## Under the hood

* Every patched build is checked before it ships. Its resource table has to match the original's, each hook may only use registers that were free where it went in, and each call a patch adds has to be where the patch put it, once.
* Added a HushGram logo and README banner in the family's style, using the pink from HushGram's settings.
* The release checks keep working after the first release. A checkout with a published index no longer stops the release tooling's own tests, an ordinary push leaves an old local bundle unread instead of refusing it after the patcher pin moves (a pushed commit that still carries the older check gets that check's own switch), and the tests now run the exact checks the pre-push hook runs for the index push, network lookups and quoted test counts included. CONTRIBUTING's release steps say what that push needs: a full test run with the fixtures, and a bundle description and GitHub description that name the release.
* The pre-push hook and the release scripts read git's output as UTF-8 every time. The machine-name scan and the hook's own git calls used the console's code page, which is 437 when a push starts in Git Bash, so a path with a letter past ASCII came back garbled. And with no console at all, Windows PowerShell 5.1 stopped with "The handle is invalid." before git ran. The fix comes from Hushfacebook.
* Release tooling, from Hushfacebook. Before a release, `scripts/build-release-receipt.ps1` patches every Instagram build the catalog declares and writes a receipt saying what applied, which toolchain built the bundle and what the patches changed in the manifest. It asks OSV about every library the bundle carries, and it writes `SHA256SUMS.txt` for the files a release publishes. When the index goes out, the pre-push hook downloads those files and checks them against both. `scripts/validate-release-facts.ps1` keeps the README, the CHANGELOG and the bug form in line with the patch list, and it works before the first release too.

Every file here is listed in `SHA256SUMS.txt`, and `release-receipt-0.0.2.json` says what applied to Instagram 449.0.0.52.84 and which toolchain built the bundle.

> **This bundle is broken.** It was published without its patch code, so Morphe Manager shows zero patches. Use [v0.43.1](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/hushfeed/releases/tag/v0.43.1) instead, which is the same 91 patches rebuilt correctly.

## What changed

One new patch, from a feature request (#7).

**Use system font.** A new switch draws TikTok's text in your device's own font instead of TikTok Sans. Turn it on under Hushfeed settings > App and restart TikTok. It is off by default.

TikTok builds every piece of interface text through one font engine, so the switch stands at that engine's exit and hands back the device font at the same weight and slant, which keeps bold headings bold. It touches only the text and display fonts. The icons, the gift animations and the @ and # glyphs load through other paths and keep their own fonts, so nothing turns into a box.

The effect is clear on a phone whose system font differs from TikTok Sans, and subtle on one still using a stock font that resembles it.

**Validation.** 1423 runtime tests and 225 patch tests passed locally. The receipt attached below records all 91 patches applying to the 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures with the real desktop CLI. The switch was checked on a Galaxy S22 on 46.2.3: with it on, text reflows to the device font while the bold headings stay bold and every icon still draws, and the diagnostic export shows the hook ran. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

Everything in this release is listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/hushfeed/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md). The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.

## Fixes

### Clipboard Enhancements

- Improved real-time refresh behavior within the Clipboard page by restoring items temporarily hidden when the stock live update path only keeps the most recent `5` timestamp groups.
- Fixed `Show order index` causing clipboard item content to become mismatched or appear to reorder while scrolling, due to `RecyclerView` view-holder reuse during live updates.
- Fixed `Show order index` labels not refreshing consistently for already-visible clipboard items after new clipboard entries were added.
- Improved clipboard live-update stability by restoring the full overridden visible list after stock adapter live-trim runs.

## Note
- Currently supports only the official Gboard 17.0.10.880768217-release-arm64-v8a.


## 修正

### 剪貼簿增強

- 改善剪貼簿頁面內的即時刷新顯示，補齊官方 stock live update 僅保留最近 `5` 個 timestamp group 時造成的暫時性列表縮減問題。
- 修正啟用 `Show order index` 後，因 `RecyclerView` 的 `ViewHolder` 重用與即時更新交互影響，導致剪貼簿內容錯位、看起來像重新排序，或滑動時項目顯示異常的問題。
- 修正啟用 `Show order index` 後，當有新的剪貼內容加入時，畫面上原本已顯示的項目編號不會同步更新，必須滑動或重新進入頁面才會部分或全部刷新編號的問題。
- 改善剪貼簿即時更新穩定性，在官方執行即時修剪後，會重新補回完整清單，避免畫面暫時縮成不完整列表。

## 注意
- 目前只支援官方 Gboard 17.0.10.880768217-release-arm64-v8a

### Gboard Continuous Backspace Repeat Haptics Patch

#### ✨ Features
- **Continuous Backspace Repeat Haptic Feedback**: Delivers continuous, crisp tactile pulses on each repeated character deletion when holding down the backspace key.
- **Full Preferences Compliance**: Honors system vibration setting, Gboard "Haptic feedback on keypress" toggle, and vibration strength/duration slider.
- **Compatible**: Works seamlessly standalone or combined with other Morphe patch suites (like `jasonwu1994/Gboard-patches`).

#### 📱 Add to Morphe App
1. Open the **Morphe** app on your Android device.
2. Navigate to **Settings** -> **Sources**.
3. Tap **Add Source** and paste:
   ```
   https://github.com/ausamnco/gboard-enc-patches
   ```
4. Return to **Patcher**, select your Gboard APK, enable **Backspace Repeat Haptic Feedback**, and patch!

Arsound — мод для Android-приложения SoundCloud со скачиванием треков, своей музыкой с телефона и плейлистами, которые открываются сразу.

**Готовый APK** (ставится без ReVanced Manager) — в Telegram-канале [t.me/arsound_git](https://t.me/arsound_git). Здесь, на GitHub, — набор патчей для ReVanced Manager.

Всё делается на телефоне, компьютер не нужен. Займёт 5–10 минут.

## Установка кратко

1. Установите [ReVanced Manager](https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-manager/releases/download/v2.6.0/revanced-manager-2.6.0.apk) и [загрузчики для ReVanced Manager](https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-manager-downloaders/releases/download/v1.2.0/revanced-manager-downloaders-1.2.0.apk). Загрузчики открывать не нужно — они работают внутри ReVanced Manager.
2. ReVanced Manager → **Патчи** → ✏️ → **Добавить патчи** → **Введите URL** → `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Allvoid/arsound/main/patches.json` → **Добавить**.
3. **Приложения** → **com.soundcloud.android** → **Патч** → на APKMirror: **2026.09.02-release**, **arm64-v8a**, **Download APK bundle** → **Установить**.

Ниже — подробная инструкция с пояснениями к каждому шагу.

---

# Установка по шагам

Понадобятся: телефон на Android 12L или новее, интернет (лучше Wi-Fi — скачается около 100 МБ) и аккаунт SoundCloud.

Ниже названия кнопок написаны **жирным** — ровно так, как они подписаны на экране. Если ReVanced Manager у вас на английском, в скобках указано английское название.

## Шаг 1. Скачайте и установите ReVanced Manager

ReVanced Manager — официальное приложение проекта ReVanced. Оно встраивает Arsound в SoundCloud.

1. Откройте на телефоне ссылку: **[revanced-manager-2.6.0.apk](https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-manager/releases/download/v2.6.0/revanced-manager-2.6.0.apk)**. Начнётся скачивание файла.
2. Когда файл скачается, нажмите на уведомление о загрузке (или откройте «Файлы» → «Загрузки» и нажмите на `revanced-manager-2.6.0.apk`).
3. Если Android напишет, что установка из этого источника запрещена, нажмите **Настройки**, включите переключатель **Разрешить из этого источника** и вернитесь назад кнопкой «Назад».
4. Нажмите **Установить**.
5. Если появится окно Google Play Защиты о неизвестном приложении — нажмите **Подробнее** → **Всё равно установить**.
6. Дождитесь надписи «Приложение установлено» и нажмите **Готово**.

## Шаг 2. Скачайте и установите загрузчики для Manager

Это дополнение к Manager: благодаря ему Manager сам скачает SoundCloud нужной версии.

1. Откройте ссылку: **[revanced-manager-downloaders-1.2.0.apk](https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-manager-downloaders/releases/download/v1.2.0/revanced-manager-downloaders-1.2.0.apk)**.
2. Установите файл так же, как в шаге 1: нажмите на скачанный файл → **Установить** → **Готово**.

Открывать это дополнение не нужно — у него нет своего экрана, оно работает внутри Manager.

## Шаг 3. Добавьте Arsound в Manager

1. Нажмите и удерживайте эту ссылку, затем выберите **Копировать ссылку** (или выделите текст и скопируйте):
   ```
   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Allvoid/arsound/main/patches.json
   ```
2. Откройте приложение **ReVanced Manager**.
3. Вверху нажмите вкладку **Патчи** (Patches).
4. В правом нижнем углу нажмите круглую кнопку с **карандашом ✏️**.
5. Внизу появится кнопка **+ Добавить патчи** — нажмите её.
6. В окне «Добавить патчи» оставьте выбранным **Введите URL** (Enter URL) и нажмите **Далее**.
7. Нажмите на поле **URL патчей**, удерживайте палец и выберите **Вставить** — в поле появится скопированная ссылка.
8. Галочку **Автообновление** оставьте включённой — тогда новые версии Arsound будут приходить сами.
9. Нажмите **Добавить**.

Проверка: на вкладке «Патчи» появилась строка **Arsound v0.7.0 • 8 патчей**. Строка «ReVanced Patches» — это официальные патчи ReVanced, её трогать не нужно.

## Шаг 4. Пропатчите SoundCloud

1. Вверху нажмите вкладку **Приложения** (Apps).
2. Нажмите на строку поиска **Поиск приложений…** и напишите `SoundCloud`.
3. Нажмите на **com.soundcloud.android**. Под названием должна быть версия **2026.09.02-release**.
   Если там другая версия — смотрите «Частые вопросы» ниже.
4. Откроется экран «Информация о приложении». Ничего менять не нужно: все патчи Arsound уже выбраны. Нажмите синюю кнопку **Патч** (Patch) в правом нижнем углу.
5. Появится окно «APKMirror — Для продолжения работы этого загрузчика требуется взаимодействие с пользователем». Нажмите **Продолжить**.
6. Внутри Manager откроется сайт APKMirror (он на английском). Дальше:
   1. Немного пролистайте вниз до «Results for …» и нажмите на **SoundCloud: The Music You Love 2026.09.02-release**.
   2. На открывшейся странице нажмите оранжевую кнопку **SCROLL TO AVAILABLE DOWNLOADS**.
   3. Появится таблица вариантов. Нажмите на оранжевую надпись **2026.09.02-release** в строке, где в колонке «Arch» написано **arm64-v8a** (обычно это первая строка). Это вариант для почти всех современных телефонов.
   4. На странице варианта пролистайте немного вниз до оранжевой кнопки **DOWNLOAD APK BUNDLE** и нажмите её.
   Реклама на сайте — это реклама APKMirror, её можно просто пролистывать.
7. Manager сам вернётся к экрану «Патчер» и начнёт работу. Вы увидите три этапа: **Подготовка**, **Патчинг**, **Сохранение** — возле каждого по очереди появятся зелёные галочки. Это занимает 2–5 минут. Не сворачивайте Manager и не блокируйте телефон.
8. Когда все три этапа станут зелёными, внизу справа появится кнопка **Установить** (Install). Нажмите её.
9. Android спросит, установить ли приложение, — нажмите **Установить**. Если появится предупреждение Google Play Защиты — **Подробнее** → **Всё равно установить**.

## Шаг 5. Откройте Arsound

1. На рабочем столе или в списке приложений появится **Arsound** со своей иконкой.
2. Откройте его и войдите в свой аккаунт SoundCloud.
3. Настройки мода: значок профиля или **Library** → шестерёнка ⚙️ → пункт **Arsound**.

Оригинальный SoundCloud удалять не нужно — Arsound ставится отдельным приложением рядом с ним.

---

# Как обновить Arsound

Когда выйдет новая версия, Manager подтянет её сам (если в шаге 3 была включена галочка «Автообновление»). Чтобы обновить приложение: откройте ReVanced Manager → **Приложения** → **com.soundcloud.android** → **Патч** и повторите шаг 4. Arsound обновится поверх, настройки и вход сохранятся.

---

# Частые вопросы

**Под com.soundcloud.android в Manager написана не 2026.09.02-release, а другая версия.**
Нажмите на com.soundcloud.android → **Выберите патчи** → в правом нижнем углу круглая кнопка со **стрелкой и часами** (сброс) → внизу появится надпись «Выбор патчей и параметры были сброшены до рекомендуемых значений» → нажмите **Сохранить**. Вернитесь назад — версия станет 2026.09.02-release.

**Строка Arsound на вкладке «Патчи» красная или пишет, что патчи не могут быть загружены.**
Проверьте интернет и что ссылка вставлена полностью. Удалите строку (✏️ → значок корзины → **Подтвердить**) и добавьте заново по шагу 3.

**Сайт APKMirror не открывается или показывает проверку «Verify you are human».**
Отметьте проверку на сайте сами, как в обычном браузере, и продолжайте с пункта 6.1.

**При установке пишет «Приложение не установлено».**
На телефоне уже есть Arsound, установленный другим способом. Удалите его (удерживайте иконку Arsound → **Удалить**) и нажмите **Установить** в Manager ещё раз.

**Android спрашивает «Открыть с помощью: SoundCloud / Arsound».**
Выберите **Arsound**.

**Трек пишет «Недоступно в вашей стране», хотя в обычном SoundCloud играет.**
В Arsound: шестерёнка ⚙️ → **Arsound** → **Сбросить данные SoundCloud**. Вход в аккаунт и настройки Arsound сохранятся.

---

# Что умеет Arsound

Всё включается и выключается в приложении: шестерёнка ⚙️ → **Arsound**.

- **Без лишнего** — нет предложений подписки Go и Go+, телеметрия выключена, вкладку Upgrade можно скрыть.
- **Скачивание** — «Скачать файл» в меню трека, проверка скачивания плейлиста без дублей, скачанное играет без интернета, лишнее удаляется из меню.
- **Поиск Arsound** — во вкладке «Поиск» переключатель «SoundCloud / Arsound»: треки, которые в SoundCloud не скачать, ищутся в YouTube Music, слушаются одним нажатием и скачиваются в «Импортированные».
- **Своя музыка** — импорт аудиофайлов с телефона, плейлист «Импортированные», любые треки в любых плейлистах, свой порядок плейлистов перетаскиванием.
- **Мгновенные плейлисты** — плейлисты и альбомы открываются сразу, даже без интернета.
- **Сеть и батарея** — свой DNS, запрет выхода в сеть с российского IP, плашка статуса сети, вопрос перед проверкой устройства, экономия батареи.
- **Плеер** — эквалайзер, статистика прослушиваний, размер и срок хранения кэша.
- **Без дубликатов** — перезаливы одного трека скрываются в рекомендациях и на главной.
- **«Для вас»** — каждый день плейлист из новых для вас треков по лайкам и плейлистам, подбирает Last.fm.
- **Оформление** — темы со своими цветами, шрифтами и анимациями, 93 иконки приложения, русский язык интерфейса.

# Что нового в 0.7.0

- **Оформление.** Настройки Arsound → **Оформление**: темы «Алый», «Кобальт», «Мята», «Сакура» и «Лайм» меняют цвета тёмной и светлой темы, акцент, шрифт, скругления обложек и мини-плеера, цвет заставки и анимации загрузки. «SoundCloud» возвращает стандартный вид.
- **Русский язык.** Интерфейс SoundCloud переведён на русский. Язык выбирается в «Оформлении»: как в системе, русский или английский.
- **Плейлист «Для вас».** Arsound смотрит лайки, плейлисты, импортированные и самые слушаемые треки, спрашивает у Last.fm, что слушают вместе с ними, и кладёт до 40 новых треков в плейлист «Для вас». Обновляется каждый день в 00:00; без сети или с российского IP — при первой возможности.
- **93 иконки приложения.** Однотонные, градиенты, светящиеся и неоновые буквы, космос, ледник, комикс, матрица, хром, иконка в цветах обоев и другие. Настройки Arsound → Оформление → **Иконка приложения**.

Hushfacebook v0.3.4 brings together all changes since v0.2.0. It targets Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 and retains support for 577.0.0.50.72. The bundle now has 43 patches, up from 27.

## What's new

- **Searchable settings.** A new overview leads to category pages, with search, clearer dialogs and a live preview for saved video names. Dark, light and wallpaper themes are supported.
- **Marketplace only.** Keep Marketplace, Notifications and your profile or Menu in the tab bar. Optional quiet social notifications and feed preloading controls are available, with a way back to regular Facebook. The mode starts off.
- More filtering controls cover suggested Stories and Groups, Menu promotions, sponsored search/profile posts and Marketplace requests. Word lists can hide or keep posts, and creator-labelled AI posts have a separate opt-in switch.
- **Playback and saves.** Tap to play clears the initial play overlay when playback starts and stops a quick swipe from carrying a tap into the next Reel. Long-video resume is available. Compatible saves preserve known H.264/AAC pairs, and audio selection favors formats more players can handle.
- Choose a custom font file, open on a chosen tab, set the default comment order, limit tag suggestions to an explicit @, and block selected promotional notifications. Hushfacebook also has an entry in Facebook's Menu.

## Update

1. Refresh the Hushfacebook source in Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. Review the new patches and select the controls you want.
2. Patch the arm64-v8a, Android 11+ bundle of Facebook **580.0.0.51.74**, build **475019344**. Facebook **577.0.0.50.72**, build **474426275**, is also supported.
3. Install over your current patched Facebook using the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key to preserve update compatibility.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook#install).

## Known limitations

Some reports still need checks on the affected phone or viewer: WhatsApp import (#11), Media settings (#12), Xiaomi Gallery audio (#14), cloned-app settings (#16) and a missing Reel Download button (#18). The original reporter's stuck-overlay viewer also needs confirmation. Marketplace can still show ads on listing-detail pages.

Review diagnostic reports before sharing them. Automatic filtering can miss structured credentials or other private text.

## Validation

Local checks passed: 984 runtime tests and 454 patch tests, with no failures or skips, plus both Android lints and the release-script checks. All 43 patches applied without forcing to both supported Facebook builds, with no resource or injected-code structural errors. The dependency advisory check passed.

The rebuilt bundle is byte-for-byte identical to the previously verified v0.3.4 bundle. The existing S22 settings and playback checks apply to the same runtime code; the affected configurations listed above remain unconfirmed.

The release includes the patch bundle, its dependency inventory (SBOM), the build and fixture receipt, and SHA-256 checksums.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

The first Hushfacebook release: 13 Morphe patches for Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 (the current release, out today) and 577.0.0.50.72, arm64-v8a.

## What it does

- Sponsored and promoted posts come out of the news feed without leaving a gap. So do suggested pages, Facebook's own upsell cards and its survey slots.
- Sponsored stories are gone, and so are the ads in Reels and Watch, including the product banners over a reel and the ads inside a video.
- Facebook stops downloading ads in the background and stops serving Audience Network ads to other apps. Ad telemetry is blocked too.
- Links open in your own browser instead of Facebook's.
- You can save any story. Reels too, if you turn that patch on, and there's an AMOLED black theme if you want one.
- Screens that break on a re-signed Facebook (some settings pages and profiles) work again.

Long-press Facebook's icon and tap Hushfacebook for the settings. Every filter has its own switch, and there's a pause switch, debug logging and a diagnostic export. If Facebook crashes three times within a minute of starting, Hushfacebook pauses itself so you can get back in.

## Installing

Add the source in Morphe Manager 1.31.0 or newer (the link is in the README), then patch the arm64-v8a Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 bundle from APKMirror. The .mpp attached here is the patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. SHA256SUMS.txt has its checksum, and the release receipt records what it was checked against.

## What was checked

All 13 patches applied to the real 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72 bundles with no manifest changes, and every stock resource still resolves in the patched APK. 72 extension tests and 72 of the 73 patch tests passed. The one left over checks that the upstream mirror links in the source notices still answer, and gitlab.com was down when this was built.

On a Samsung Galaxy S25 with Android 16, Morphe Manager patched Facebook 580 with the default selection and installed it as an update over an older patched copy. The account stayed signed in and Facebook ran without a crash. Nobody has confirmed yet that each filter removes what it should on a live feed, so bug reports with a diagnostic export are very welcome.

## Where it comes from

Most patches are ported from Andrew Liang's Morphe patches and fixed for 580. FroggoMorphePatches contributed ideas, and Hushfeed the build, the shared extension library and the release checks. All of it is GPL-3.0. docs/sources.md covers every Facebook patch source we looked at.

# Music telemetry 0.1.2

For YouTube Music **8.40.54**, with ReVanced Manager **2.6.0 or newer**.

## Changes

- Capture the full loaded playback queue as `playback_queue`, preserving song order, duplicates, queue IDs and available metadata.
- Capture opened playlists as `playlist_snapshot`, including loaded off-screen songs, video/occurrence/browse IDs, text, descriptions and mapped artwork.
- Record playlist entry as `music_action` / `playlist_playback_started` when playlist context matches a loaded track.
- Record song/queue/off repeat-button selections as `repeat_mode_changed`, with numeric `repeatMode` and readable `repeatModeName`.
- Record accepted Up Next song clicks as `queue_song_selected`, retaining the selected song and queue occurrence separately from the current player.
- Revalidate existing `like`, `dislike` and `remove_rating` hooks with exact request targets.
- Preserve retry IDs, chunk large snapshots, retain partial-source scope during reassembly and report sanitized capture failures.

## Install

Refresh the existing ReVanced Manager source:

`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ThetaBird/revanced-telemetry/main/patches.json`

Repatch the original YouTube Music 8.40.54 APK. Select **Native playback queue telemetry**, **Opened playlist snapshots**, **Repeat mode telemetry**, and **Playback queue selection telemetry** alongside the core telemetry patch and any existing optional patches. Keep the same signing identity when updating an installed APK.

The attached `.rvp` is the patch bundle. Its `.sha256` attachment provides the checksum. Configure the collector in **Settings → Listen telemetry**; the bundle contains no collector credentials.

## Receiver and coverage

Deploy the companion Listen receiver change [`91f5cde`](https://github.com/ThetaBird/listen/commit/91f5cde) before sending `playback_queue`. All action events use the existing private `music_action` path and do not affect public now-playing.

App snapshots contain currently loaded data and carry `complete: false`; they do not force playlist pagination. Unmapped/opaque YouTube metadata is omitted. Rating events observe request construction, playlist entry observes a track load, and queue clicks observe command dispatch—not confirmed server acceptance or audible playback. Signed-in live UI behavior remains unverified.

## Validation

35 Kotlin patch tests, 18 Python tests, strict Android compilation and the Android instrumentation suite passed. The supplied APK was patched successfully with all eight telemetry patches and GmsCore support; injected-hook audits and APK signature checks passed. The release workflow rebuilds and tests the versioned bundle before publishing it.

X（旧 Twitter）の Android アプリで、タイムラインに出る「ポストをさらに表示」の中身を自動で読み込み、ボタンを隠す Morphe 用のパッチです。

1.0.0 からの主な変更点：

- 裏の読み込みと自動タップを組み合わせて動くようにしました。裏で読み込めなかったボタン（読み込みの上限に達した後のもの、裏の読み込みが働かない画面のもの、裏で読み込んでも何も入らなかったもの）は、画面に来た時に自動でタップします
- ポストの詳細（返信の画面）でも、返信の続きを裏で読み込むようにしました
- 読み込み終わったボタンを端末に記録し、X を起動し直した後も、読み込み直さずに隠すようにしました
- オプション「裏での取得を使わず、自動タップだけにする」を「画面に出る前に裏で読み込む」（既定オン）に置き換え、並びを「裏で読み込む → 隠す → トースト → 診断ログ」に変えました。自動タップだけにしていた場合は、新しいオプションをオフにしてください
- 自動タップで読み込みが始まらなかった時は、もう一度タップするようにしました。それでも始まらなければ、ボタンを表示したままにします
- 要求の上限を、裏の読み込みと自動タップを合わせて1分に10回にまとめました
- 診断ログを読みやすくしました（日付の見出し、記録の種類、画面の名前、パッチの版）。ログは英語で書きます
- 「隠す」をオフにしている時に、裏で読み込み中のボタンに読み込み中の表示を出すための処理を加えました
- 読み込み終わったボタンを5分ごとに読み込み直していた問題と、タイムラインの先頭に新しいポストが入った時などに、裏の読み込みの結果を取り違えることがあった問題を直しました

対応バージョンは X（`com.twitter.android`）`12.19.1-release.0` です。使い方と注意点は README を見てください。
